hypothesis: The legacy character bigram bonus is conditional on word segmentation although character LM already scores those transitions. It can favor wrong word splits. Test removing only INTERNAL_BIGRAM when an LM is active; preserve external context, spelling, lexical priors and no-LM/personal-new-word fallback.

development.gate: Each domain top1/top5/recall255 nondecreasing and total top1 character errors nonincreasing; summed top1 strictly improves. Retain all individual losses.
development.selection: Eligible only: maximum combined top1, minimum combined errors, maximum combined top5, prefer daily-only if tied. Both development slices are known; no new coefficient sweep.

test.gate: Same per-domain nonregression and combined strict top1 gain; one selected mode, no tuning after test. Require repeated output and later Android/short-input/personal-word acceptance before promotion.

production: Default internalBigramWeight remains 1 until measured acceptance; no-LM fallback remains unchanged even when the host calibration is zero.
